activity.notes: Juan José Arévalo assumed the Guatemalan presidency on 15 March 1945 after the 1944 Revolution and completed the constitutional six-year term on 15 March 1951.

sources.title: Historia Política de Guatemala, Siglo XX — CEUR/USAC
sources.citation_text: The University of San Carlos history center states that Arévalo took office on 15 March 1945 for a six-year presidential term ending in 1951.

sources.title: Discurso del Doctor Juan José Arévalo, Presidente Constitucional 1945-1951 — SICultura Guatemala
sources.citation_text: Arévalo's transfer-of-power address states that he assumed the presidency on 15 March 1945 and handed over power on 15 March 1951.
